name: Albania
summary: Possession for personal use 'in small doses' is excluded from the drug-dealing offence (Criminal Code art. 283) but read narrowly (about one dose); more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs). Art. 283 is under review.
poisonControlNote: No poison information centre is listed in WHO's 2023 directory; the QSUT 'Mother Teresa' hospital in Tirana has a clinical toxicology service.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law or other specific legal protection for people who call for help in an overdose was found.

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I; mushrooms presumably treated likewise. Small own-use doses aren't a crime (art. 283).

dmt.note: UN Schedule I (ayahuasca contains DMT). Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I; cacti status not confirmed. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC are UN Schedule I. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

nbomes.note: UN Schedule I since 2015. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T compounds are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO tryptamines are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

cannabis.note: Own use in small doses isn't a crime (art. 283); cultivation: 3–7 yrs. A July 2023 law allows licensed medical/industrial cultivation.

ketamine.note: Anaesthetic used in hospitals and veterinary practice; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

dxm.note: Not UN-controlled; national control and prescription status not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not internationally controlled; no national restriction confirmed.

amphetamines.note: UN Schedule II. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

cocaine.note: 1961 Convention drug. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

alcohol.note: 18+: sales to minors are banned and under-18s may not drink in public places.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II (small own-use doses not a crime). GBL/1,4-BD status not confirmed.

opioids.note: Heroin etc. are controlled. Own use in small doses isn't a crime (CC art. 283), read narrowly; more is prosecuted as dealing (5–10 yrs).

tramadol.note: Prescription-only painkiller; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; harmala/Syrian rue status not confirmed; ayahuasca contains DMT (controlled).
